action.description: `translate` is charged: every new language costs `ceil(duration / 60)` minutes. `dubbing` and `transcribe` cost `0`: `transcribe` here means transcribing a recording that exists again (retranscription). The first transcription of a file is charged when you add the recording with `POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/recordings`, and cannot be estimated beforehand.

languages.description: Target languages of `translate` or `dubbing`. Not needed for `transcribe`.

ignoredLanguages.description: Languages you will skip, as in the translate request. They cost nothing.
